caption:
Your automated follow-up text might be going nowhere.

Since February 2025, major U.S. carriers block unregistered business SMS. No delay. No filter. No warning.

If your missed-call text-back, appointment reminders, or review requests run through an unregistered number, they can fail while your dashboard still reads "sent."

This week, ask your texting platform one question: is my number registered and approved for this use case?

If they can't answer, the system you pay for may not work.

Want your follow-up system checked end to end?
DM SCALE

#SpeedToLead #SmsMarketing #LeadFollowUp #ServiceBusiness #SmallBusinessGrowth
rationale: A genuinely current carrier-enforcement shift (100% blocking of unregistered A2P 10DLC traffic since Feb 2025) that can silently break the exact automated texting Black Arrow's core promise depends on, taught as a this-week check in the reach-favoring reel format.
